sn34.1:1.4: One bhikkhu is skilled in concentration but not in entering it.
sn34.1:1.5: One bhikkhu is not skilled in concentration but is skilled in entering it.
sn34.1:1.6: One bhikkhu is skilled neither in concentration nor in entering it.
sn34.1:1.7: One bhikkhu is skilled both in concentration and in entering it.
sn34.1:1.8: Of these, the bhikkhu skilled in concentration and in entering it is the foremost, best, chief, highest, and finest of the four.
sn34.1:1.9: From a cow comes milk, from milk comes curds, from curds come butter, from butter comes ghee, and from ghee comes cream of ghee. And the cream of ghee is said to be the best of these.
sn34.1:1.10: In the same way, the bhikkhu skilled in concentration and entering it is the foremost, best, leading, highest, and finest of the four.”
